note: Runner self-checks for host-independent setups. $LSTART1 is filled in the zone of the helper call that reads it: a step's own tz, a TZ in a step's env, else the case's; a lock owned by pid 1 with that start time is a live owner (pin: REFUSED pin-locked), where a start time read in another zone would read as stale and be taken over. The zones are POSIX TZ strings, so no tz database is needed. A case whose vars take $LSTART1 and whose step runs in another zone stops with a runner error. The %V entries LSTART1 and RUNNER_LSTART (a call recorder's map reads them) stay in the runner's own zone whatever the step's. A case that needs a tool not on PATH, or runs in a zone with no tz database file on the host and no exact POSIX form, prints a `# TODO not run:` line that the summary counts as not run (neither passed nor skipped), and the run does not fail on it. A fixed-offset zone (Etc/GMT-3) has an exact POSIX form (<+03>-3), which helper calls get on a host without its tz database file; a zone with DST rules has none. bin_mirror links every entry of a folder but the excepted names (a PATH without git on hosts where /bin is /usr/bin)
